title: Understanding the Model Parameters
text: Consider what each parameter in the models represents. For example, \( \theta_{in} \) is associated with height in inches. Think about how changing this parameter affects the predicted BMI.

title: Confidence Intervals and Zero
text: A confidence interval that includes zero suggests that the parameter might not be significantly different from zero. Consider how this applies to the parameters in the models.

title: Analyzing \( \theta_{in} \)
text: Does the confidence interval for \( \theta_{in} \) likely include zero? Consider the role of height in inches in predicting BMI.
